description: Angry Duck 1.8.13: is it healthy, what is it delivering, what is stuck or broken and which components that hits. Pick data source, cluster, then narrow by node, registry, component or image.

spec.title: Workers up
spec.description: Nodes whose Angry Duck worker is running and following containerd's events.

spec.title: Images stuck pulling
spec.description: Images some node can't pull right now (pods in ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull). Angry Duck rescues them from peers.

spec.title: Broken images
spec.description: Images registered on a node that can't start a container. The node repairs them in place, from peers first, then the registry.

spec.title: Registry traffic avoided
spec.description: Bytes nodes got from this node or a peer instead of the registry, over the time range: mirror, spreads from peers, rescues and repairs from peers.

spec.expr: (sum(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="peer"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="received"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="peer"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

spec.title: Nodes cleaning disk
spec.description: Nodes whose disk went above GC_HIGH and are removing unused images until GC_LOW.

spec.title: Running version
spec.description: Angry Duck version per process. More than one value means a rollout is in progress.

spec.title: Bytes kept off the registry
spec.description: How nodes got content without the registry, per second: from the mirror (this node or a peer), spreads from peers, rescues, repairs from peers.

spec.title: Problems over time
spec.description: Images stuck pulling and broken images, across the selected nodes.

spec.title: Nodes
spec.description: One row per node. Click a node to show only it.

spec.expr: max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) + (max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_stalled{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) or max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) * 0)

sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result=~"local|peer"}[$__range])) / sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Spreads running
spec.description: Each image being spread to the nodes, and how many nodes are in each state. Filtered by image.

spec.title: Last spread took
spec.description: From the push to the last node registering the image, for the last spread that completed.

spec.title: Nodes still missing an image
spec.description: Bytes and layers of the image each node still lacks, while a spread runs. Filtered by node and image.

spec.title: Spread download: registry vs peers
spec.description: Bytes per second nodes received for spreads, by where from. The more from peers, the less the registry serves.

spec.title: Seed pulls from the registry
spec.description: Whole-image pulls the controller ordered on seed nodes, by result. cancelled: a peer delivered first.

spec.title: Spreads finished
spec.description: Spreads that ended, by result: complete (every eligible node has it), superseded (a newer tag came), expired.

spec.title: Stuck pulling
spec.description: Pods that can't pull an image, per node and image, and failed rescue attempts in a row. Filtered by node and image.

spec.title: Broken images
spec.description: Images registered on a node that can't start a container right now. The node keeps repairing them until it can.

spec.title: Pods waiting on these images
spec.description: Pods whose containers wait on a stuck or broken image, with kubelet's reason (from kube-state-metrics).

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod, image, reason) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}, "image", "$1", "image_spec", "(.+)") * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, container) group_left (reason) kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", reason=~"ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull|CreateContainerError"}) and on (image) (group by (image) (angryduck_controller_rescue_stuck_pods{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$image"}) or group by (image) (angryduck_worker_broken_image{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$image"}))

spec.title: Components hit
spec.description: Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets and CronJobs using a stuck or broken image (from kube-state-metrics).

spec.title: Rescues
spec.description: What the controller decided for each stuck pull, by result: success, failure, no_source (no peer has it), no_target, pull_policy_always.

spec.title: Repairs
spec.description: Broken images repaired in place, or not (retried at the next check), and repair orders the controller sent when a container failed to start.

spec.title: Mirror hit ratio
spec.description: Share of the content requests containerd sent to the mirror that this node or a peer answered, over the time range. The rest went to the registry.

spec.title: Mirror requests
spec.description: Content requests containerd sent to the mirror, by result: local, peer, miss (went to the registry), error.

spec.title: Registries
spec.description: Distinct images held on nodes, per registry, by what the registry answered at the last check.

spec.title: Images the registry no longer serves
spec.description: Images on nodes whose registry answered missing or denied, how many nodes still hold a copy, and the components using them. Once the last copy goes, nothing can pull it again.
